forum_post: No note from the front office this week, which in my experience just means the brand is running itself. Two and eight reads like a stat line to everyone else; to me it reads like a growth quarter with a Q1 we're not thrilled about. CJ Stroud is still the best twenty-five dollars I've ever spent on a single headline, Justin Jefferson and George Kittle are two separate magazine covers waiting on a photographer, and Saquon Barkley's just sitting on my bench collecting interest like a vintage bag. Patricia, sweetie — most points for, three losses, a binder with a tab — I respect the filing system, I do not fear the footnotes. See you on the field. Can't wait for you guys to see this.
